desc:
Ecom Swift LLC offers a WooCommerce store management starter: a fixed first round of backups, safe updates, listing edits and order checks, so you can see how we look after a shop before committing to more.

## What is a WooCommerce management starter?

A WooCommerce management starter is a single, fixed round of upkeep on your store. It covers the routine jobs that keep a shop healthy: backing up, updating software, tidying products, checking orders and removing clutter. It is not a monthly plan. You get a clear report at the end, and you decide whether ongoing care makes sense.

## Why upkeep gets neglected

Store owners are busy selling. Updates wait for a quiet week that never comes. Backups run, or seem to. Product details drift out of date, coupons expire without anyone noticing and a failed order email goes unseen for days.

Neglected stores drift toward trouble. Old plugin versions can clash with newer WordPress releases or leave security gaps. Stale listings show wrong prices or products that are no longer in stock. None of these faults announces itself. They simply sit there until a customer complains or a page stops loading.

## How routine care protects revenue

A shop earns money when four things work together: the site loads, the catalog is accurate, checkout accepts payment and emails reach customers. Routine upkeep protects each one. A backup means a bad update is a short problem instead of a lost store. Testing updates on a staging copy first means customers never see a broken page.

Checking orders and stock for errors catches problems that cost sales quietly, such as an order stuck in a pending state or an email that never went out. Clean data also helps your own decisions, since you can trust the figures you read. The value is in avoided losses and steadier running, and it is hard to put a figure on in advance.

## What a good starter round includes

- A full backup of files and database before anything changes.
- Updates to WordPress, WooCommerce and plugins, tried on staging first where your host offers it.
- A check of stock levels and prices on a sample of your products.
- A review of failed orders and transactional emails.
- Product listings added or edited from information you supply.
- Cleanup of spam, old draft orders and unused data.
- Coupons and sale prices set up or retired.
- A security scan with fixes for what it finds.
- A short written report of everything we did and what to do next.

## How we work

We begin with a backup, because every other task depends on it. We then update the software in a safe order, test the main paths, and only apply the changes to the live store once they pass. Product work follows from the lists or spreadsheets you send us.

The Basic package covers the update round and checks on orders and stock. Standard adds a batch of listing work, order and spam cleanup, coupons and a security scan. Premium goes further with a larger batch of listings, database and image cleanup, an uptime alert, an issue log with next steps and a period of follow-up fixes. If you want us to continue after the starter, we quote monthly care separately.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send product changes in one organized spreadsheet or document.
- Tell us about any customizations so updates do not undo them.
- Keep a record of passwords in your own password manager, not in messages.
- Read the report and act on the next steps.

**Avoid:**
- Updating everything on the live store at once without a backup.
- Leaving unused plugins installed because they might be needed someday.
- Editing prices in bulk without a copy of the old values.
- Assuming a quiet inbox means all emails are being delivered.

## Who this is for

This service suits an owner who has not updated the store for months and is afraid to try, a seller who needs a batch of new products added quickly, and a business that wants to test working with us before choosing ongoing support. It also suits a shop that has just been handed over from a previous developer.

## What we need from you

Send the store address, the product changes you want made and any customizations we should protect. We join through an administrator or shop manager user created for us, with hosting access as an invited user if your host supports it. We never need your password. Customer emails and support messages stay with you.
